source_geometry.coverage_method: Natural Earth physical connected parts clipped to fixed Lambert-93 50 km cells selected by the dated France record. Coordinates of the political or administrative borders are not copied into land. Retain Paris, refine only non-simple physical parts to 25/5 km, reject sub-1 km2 new fragments.
source_geometry.source_scale: Natural Earth 1:10,000,000; generated coarse game partition
source_geometry.water_policy: GENERALIZED_PHYSICAL_MASK; inland waters not classified; existing Paris surfaces retained
source_geometry.international_edge_policy: Cells can straddle dated borders; unresolved sovereignty/control are explicit and no foreign-state simulation is created.

projection.basis: RGF93 / Lambert-93, GRS80; fixed national projection. WGS84/RGF93 approximation about 1m, not survey-level conversion.

initial_politics.sovereignty_basis: HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE: the 1900 Paris and environs guide and existing French political identity support this bounded Paris basin scope. Physical mainland inclusion supplies no sovereignty or administration.
initial_politics.controller_basis: INITIAL_WORLD_ASSUMPTION: France controls this bounded Paris basin opening scope on 1900-01-01. No universal controller=sovereign rule.
initial_politics.source_locator: Baedeker Paris and its environs, 14th English edition, 1900; existing Paris Local evidence / Versailles source leaf 427
